rationale: M14.0.F6 drove this fixture (2026-09-15). Groovy enum constants (`HAPPY, GLOOMY`) are also a legal untyped field with two declarators, and the rebuilt #841 grammar resolved the declared [enum_constant, _variable_declarator_id] conflict toward the FIELD: `enum_body` contained ZERO enum_constant nodes, so the analyzer's enum_constant handling was dead code and constants produced no symbol at all. Measured pre-fix parse of exactly this file: `field_declaration type: (identifier GLOOMY) declarator: (variable_declarator name: Mood)` followed by `constructor_declaration name: flip` — a field and a constructor where the source has two constants, a method and a ternary. The grammar now emits enum_constant (the F6 lane's `enum_constant` uncovered=0 is the same fact from the other side), and the expectation pins what the analyzer does with them plus forbid entries for those two pre-fix nodes.

forbidSymbols.name: GLOOMY
forbidSymbols.note: pre-fix: the constant read as an untyped field

forbidSymbols.name: flip
forbidSymbols.note: pre-fix: `Mood flip()` read as a constructor of the bogus field's type

forbidRelationships.note: pre-fix: the enum header line, never where a constant is written
